description.tr: Türkçe ilk resimli cerrahi atlasını yazdı — cerrahi prosedürleri gösteren 140 minyatür resim, ortaçağ dünyasının en detaylı cerrahi illüstrasyonları || Sabuncuoğlu, Zehrâvî'nin Tasrîf'i üzerine inşa etti ama 140 orijinal minyatür illüstrasyon ekledi. || [Tarih notu] Uzel'in 1992 tıpkıbasım edisyonu uluslararası dikkat çekti.
description.en: Wrote the first illustrated surgical atlas in Turkish — 140 miniature paintings showing surgical procedures, the most detailed surgical illustrations of the medieval world. Source material mentions his 'illustrated surgical manual' || Sabuncuoğlu built on Zahrawi's Tasrif but added 140 original miniature illustrations — the first illustrated surgical manual in any Turkic language. He documented techniques for cauterization, tumor removal, and eye surgery. His illustrations are the most detailed surgical images produced before the European Renaissance. || [Historiographical note] Uzel's 1992 facsimile edition brought international attention. The illustrations are now in the Bibliothèque nationale de France and the Fatih Millet Library.
description.ar: كتب أول أطلس جراحي مصوّر بالتركية — ١٤٠ رسمة مصغّرة تُظهر الإجراءات الجراحية || بنى صابونجي أوغلو على تصريف الزهراوي لكن أضاف ١٤٠ رسمة مصغّرة أصلية — أول كتاب جراحي مصوّر بلغة تركية
